statement: The uncharged second operator moment has exact partition pairing 4hE h! U_h, where U_h=(1/(2h))F(FA+2A d/du_1), A=exp(L), and F=sum_(r>=1)(-1)^(r-1)r u_r. The full common-label pairing is singular for every h>=2 by an explicit uniform kernel construction. Independent normal-ordered checks cover 594 entries through weight 6. Rank p(h)-p(h-2) and the cubic U_h(U_h-1)(U_h+(h-2)/h)=0 are exact finite observations through weight 10, not all-size claims. No actual quadratic filter, SAT bound improvement or selected-result change is claimed.

Prove or refute the finite rank formula and spectral cubic at all weights
For a quadratic crossing filter, prove uniform invertibility and pay both ranks, inverse heights, entries and recursive overheads
